description: Flomaktsomhet beregnet, Røros kommune is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Røros kommune. For deler av Røros sentrum har NVE beregnet flomfare, i tillegg har kommunen selv beregnet aktsomhetsområde flom ved å benytte Qgis. Disse datasettene er smeltet sammen til flomaktsomhet, de beste dataene er derfor tilgjengelig der de finnes. Utgangspunktet for analysen er 11 m terrengmodell som er lastet ned fra høydedata.no. Coverage: Røros kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Røros kommune. Its keywords include Samfunnssikkerhet, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget, Local, Røros kommune. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
